criteria.reason: Candidate makes no claims of external audit, real-time queries, or independent verification. Source notes are purely descriptive of input file cell locations and computational methodology ('Actual net capex = capex - disposals - contributions; difference = actual - forecast'). No audit or verification language present anywhere in the workbook.
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。

criteria.reason: Candidate's explanatory text contains only computational methodology descriptions and asset class groupings, all verifiable from the input file. No assertions about company operations, business events, market conditions, or other operating facts beyond what is directly derivable from the input spreadsheet data.
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。

limitations: 原始明细缺少独立evidence、程序reason或运行字段时保留null；已有裁判reasoning逐字保留。
正项score表示正确程度；负项score表示违规程度，sdk_value与raw原样保留。

未查到唯一完成时间则finished_at保留null；不以文件修改时间代替。
